title: Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: Delicious empanadas filled with flavorful chicken, perfect for a dinner or snack.
instructions: In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add chicken broth, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Let chicken cool before shredding it.
Roll out empanada dough and cut into circles using a cookie cutter or glass.
Place a tablespoon of shredded chicken in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press edges to seal.
Brush tops with egg wash (beaten egg mixed with a little water) and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Optional: Sprinkle shredded cheese on top of empanadas before baking.
